name: @envigoinnovations/subscriby-agentic-kit
description: The Subscriby Agentic Kit: a Claude Code plugin marketplace with the skills, commands, agents, hooks and evals that teach Claude to work with Subscriby
author: Envigo Innovations <support@subscriby.net>

scripts.validate: node scripts/claude.mjs plugin validate --strict . && node scripts/claude.mjs plugin validate --strict plugins/subscriby && node scripts/claude.mjs plugin validate --strict plugins/subscriby-guard
scripts.gate: npm run lint && npm run check && npm test && npm run validate
scripts.eval: node scripts/claude.mjs plugin eval plugins/subscriby --trust-plugin --runs 1 -j 2 --max-cost-usd 10 --judge-model sonnet --no-publish
